findings.title: Missing unified spending control center
findings.changes: Opt-in USD daily/weekly/monthly/provider/project/shared-task reservation caps; exact expiring one-shot expensive-operation review; owner-estimate ceilings clearly distinct from real invoices; real owner-scoped atomic SQL enforcement before shared provider dispatch; unknown-cost holds; exact USD OpenRouter receipt settlement with BYOK/submicro limits; owner invoice corrections and bounded JSON export; deliberate bounded official free-text pricing verification; fleet retry after pre-dispatch refusal requires fresh tool authorization and cannot replay closed or unknown dispatches. Primary/helper, RPC speech/research, HTTP voice, media and hosted Build dispatch paths are wired through shared reservation/settlement helpers with exact provider/model and available project/task identities; model-less or unpriced paths fail closed while monetary policy is enabled. Integration review also fixes exact-byte unsent-input Speak retry, exact-request unsent-answer retry without repeating STT, ambiguous-input replay refusal, and one task budget spanning input/answer/output. The bounded HTTP agent now reserves every actual model round separately with stable root/step identities and one task/project budget, exact body digests, fresh halt/privacy/catalogue/credential checks, conservative unknown-cost receipts, initial-only safe approval retry and preserved prior tool logs on later refusal.
findings.evidence: 53/53 targeted regressions passed, zero skips (financial-test-final.log). Real isolated in-memory PGlite migrations0019+0021; synthetic provider receipts and controlled timing; normal test inventory discovers every new test file. Targeted ESLint passed. Final combined typecheck/build/full-suite and browser outcomes remain pending until recorded in docs/audits/c3-continue-production/VERIFICATION.md; earlier scoped runs are not promoted to final-build proof. Final integration supplement: 45/45 Speak + financial fixtures passed (speak-retry-integration.log), zero skips, and scoped lint passed. Input audio and original answer JSON are bounded ephemeral snapshots only; no real provider was called. Bounded-agent integration:77/77 targeted regressions passed,0skipped (agent-model-dispatch-tests.log), including11 new real isolated SQL/fake-provider cases plus existing bounded-agent/auth/body/mount contracts. Scoped ESLint passed. This scoped run does not establish final combined build or live provider proof.
findings.still_needed: No live provider call, external DB, actual invoice, browser money-policy save or production migration was exercised. Monetary limits constrain owner-estimated commitments; upstream bills can exceed estimates and cannot be guaranteed. A receipt absent USD, below supported microdollar precision or indicating BYOK stays unknown until invoice reconciliation. JSON export intentionally shows latest1000 ledger rows and latest1000 correction rows with incompleteHistory. Only fresh official OpenRouter all-zero known price fields plus compatible text-only configuration qualify automatically as free; custom endpoints/model-less sessions remain unverified. Migration0021 must precede deployment; no deployment performed.
